title: Following the Mangadex DMCA hit
content: The recent DMCA takedown notice resulted in the removal of thousands of titles from Mangadex, including our release. From now on, we will use the Cubari as a backup.

title: Our Discord server is online
content: Since updating via the website takes time, it is recommended that you join the server for a faster update. You can also discuss the series there.

title: Hello Buddy!
content: This will be our website for announcing and showcasing our work.
